title: Sailing boat with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sky glow waves -->
  <path d='M5,78 Q20,72 35,78 Q50,84 65,78 Q80,72 95,78 L95,88 Q80,82 65,88 Q50,94 35,88 Q20,82 5,88 Z' fill='#1a8fb5'/>
  <!-- hull -->
  <path d='M15,68 L25,80 L75,80 L85,68 Z' fill='#e85d3a'/>
  <path d='M15,68 L25,80 L75,80 L85,68 Z' fill='none' stroke='#ff9a6b' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- hull stripe -->
  <path d='M20,72 L80,72' stroke='#ffcc66' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- mast -->
  <rect x='48' y='18' width='4' height='50' fill='#c49a3c' rx='1'/>
  <!-- sail main -->
  <path d='M52,22 L78,62 L52,62 Z' fill='#fff4d6'/>
  <path d='M52,22 L78,62 L52,62 Z' fill='none' stroke='#ffe08a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- sail small -->
  <path d='M46,28 L26,62 L46,62 Z' fill='#ffe9b0'/>
  <path d='M46,28 L26,62 L46,62 Z' fill='none' stroke='#fff4d6' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- flag -->
  <path d='M50,16 L62,20 L50,24 Z' fill='#ff5e7e'/>
  <!-- face on hull -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='73' rx='3' ry='3' fill='#3c2a1e'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='73' rx='3' ry='3' fill='#3c2a1e'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='72' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='72' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42,77 Q50,83 58,77' fill='none' stroke='#3c2a1e' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='76' r='2.5' fill='#ff8a8a' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='76' r='2.5' fill='#ff8a8a' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
